narrative.overview:
Wave is a modern, simple maker portfolio with the flat composition of the user's Arduino reference and a restrained purple, cyan, white, and black palette. White and near-white reading surfaces carry black typography; a single purple word emphasizes the hero. The hero uses a CSS 3D Rubik loop; actual project imagery leads the gallery. The same visual language accommodates AI, software engineering, and robotics without assigning one discipline greater visual importance.

The page uses flat, predominantly neutral fields, Manrope typography, open project layouts, quiet borders, and small purple/cyan accents. The original personal logo remains black.
keyCharacteristics: Real project artifacts on near-neutral fields with faint purple/cyan tints.
Bold Manrope headings with compact supporting labels.
Flat rectangles, small control radii, and sparse one-pixel rules.
Black actions, deep-purple type and hover, small cyan accents, and visible keyboard focus.
Open desktop grids that become a single reading column on mobile.
Original personal logo in black, shared across site identity.

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.body: Neutral surfaces lead. Keep purple/cyan as measured accents, preserve readable text contrast, and let real project imagery lead the page. No saturated full-width hero, large text highlight rectangle, gradients, or decorative shadows.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope for interface text and editorial headings; hierarchy comes from size, weight, tracking, and spacing.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Preserve depth through color, line, and artifact overlap; do not add shadows or gradients to cards or controls.

rules.name: The Visible State Rule
rules.body: Preserve the implemented focus outlines, selected filter/page/image contrast, and announced copy, project-range, and image-count feedback when reusing these controls.

dos: **Do** use the source palette and self-hosted Manrope family.
**Do** place real screenshots and robotics photos on the established flat artifact fields.
**Do** keep textual cards open and separate sections with sparse one-pixel rules.
**Do** retain visible keyboard focus, semantic links and buttons, live feedback, and reduced-motion support.
**Do** allow filters, tags, long email addresses, and content columns to wrap at narrow widths.
donts: **Don't** add gradients, decorative shadows, or glass effects to this flat visual system.
**Don't** turn rectangular project artifacts into rounded floating cards.
**Don't** use the quiet artifact-backdrop colors as invented semantic status colors.
**Don't** replace real project imagery with generic illustrations or invented application screenshots.
**Don't** make essential content depend on an entrance animation.
